problem_statement: devhau/startup-template (rebranded here as 'Tidechart', a tide and coastal-weather forecasting product for harbor operators and coastal crews) is a static UIdeck Play-style Bootstrap marketing site served directly from static HTML with assets/css/ud-styles.css (a shared navbar, hero, feature cards, a three-tier pricing section, FAQ accordion and contact block across index.html, pricing.html and contact.html). The pricing section (#pricing) ships three plan cards (BERTH / HARBOR / COASTLINE) with fixed monthly prices but no way to switch billing period. Enhance the site's OWN pricing feature with a Monthly / Yearly billing control, and integrate it consistently across the site while preserving the Play visual system (blue accent, LineIcons rhythm, Bootstrap grid, section spacing): (1) ADD a billing switch to the pricing section — a '.plan-billing' bar with a 'Billing' label, a Monthly/Yearly toggle and a '#billing-readout' line — and give each plan card a monthly and a yearly price (data-monthly / data-yearly on the .plan-price / .plan-note nodes). Make the plan grid and the billing bar stay within the viewport on a 390px phone and an 834px tablet with no horizontal document overflow; do not merely clip them with overflow-x:hidden — the document itself must not exceed the viewport width. (2) Place the SAME billing control consistently on the home pricing section, the pricing page AND the contact page (section modifiers plan-billing--home / --pricing / --contact) so the billing switch is a site-wide fixture, not a home-only afterthought. (3) Keep the pricing grid in the brand-blue Play palette (light surface, rounded white plan cards, the blue 'popular' card) and make it visually faithful to the reference in the Yearly state — the plan cards must not overlap, clip or wash out into illegible text when a period is selected. (4) Wire the billing toggle end to end: clicking 'Yearly' must swap every plan card's price to its yearly figure (e.g. HARBOR '$ 89/mo' → '$ 890/yr'), update the plan note to 'billed yearly · 2 months free', and set '#billing-readout' to 'Billing: Yearly · 2 months free' (and back on 'Monthly'); the post-click terminal state must reflect the selected period, not stay frozen on Monthly. Keep the navbar, hero, feature cards, FAQ accordion collapse, mobile navbar toggler and all local hero/brand/team assets intact, and keep the browser console clean.
required_content: The pricing section (#pricing) gains a '.plan-billing' control (a 'Billing' label, a Monthly/Yearly toggle and a '#billing-readout' line) and the plan grid + billing bar stay within the viewport on a 390px phone and 834px tablet with no horizontal document overflow beyond 24px.

The same billing control appears consistently on the home pricing section, the pricing page AND the contact page (plan-billing--home / --pricing / --contact) — one shared control in all three places, not only on the home page.

The plan grid keeps the Play look (light surface, rounded white plan cards, the blue 'popular' card) and is visually faithful to the reference in the Yearly state — the cards do not overlap, clip or wash out into illegible text.

The billing toggle is wired end to end: clicking Yearly swaps every plan price to its yearly figure (HARBOR '$ 89/mo' → '$ 890/yr'), updates the note to 'billed yearly · 2 months free' and sets '#billing-readout' to 'Billing: Yearly · 2 months free'; the post-click terminal state reflects the selected period, not the default Monthly.
The desktop (1440px) and tablet (834px) layouts stay within their viewports and the plan cards stack/wrap cleanly on 390px mobile.

The navbar, hero, feature cards, FAQ accordion collapse, mobile navbar toggler and local hero/brand/team assets remain reachable and unchanged, and the static site keeps a clean browser console (no remote CDN/ad/font errors).
design_constraints: Build the pricing plan grid and the '.plan-billing' bar so they wrap/shrink within a 390px phone and 834px tablet; do not force a fixed-width nowrap row or fake the fix with overflow-x:hidden.
Place the SAME billing control on the home pricing section, pricing AND contact pages so it is consistent site-wide; do not add it to only one page.

Preserve the UIdeck Play visual language: blue primary accent, rounded plan cards, LineIcons rhythm, Bootstrap grid columns and section spacing; the Yearly state must render the plan cards cleanly, not overlapping/clipped/illegible.
Wire the billing toggle end to end (the plan prices, the plan notes and the #billing-readout must all reflect the clicked period), not merely a class toggle.
Keep the static HTML/CSS architecture and all local hero/brand/team assets; do not add a framework, build tool, route system, package dependency, remote font, ad script, or CDN.
state_constraints: desktop_initial, tablet_initial and mobile_initial verify the Tidechart hero, navbar wordmark and local hero imagery render consistently across viewports with no horizontal overflow.
desktop_pricing_default, mobile_pricing_default and tablet_pricing_default verify the pricing plan grid + billing bar render in the brand-blue palette and stay within the phone/tablet viewport.

desktop_pricing_yearly and mobile_pricing_yearly click the Yearly period and verify the plan grid stays clean (no overlap/clip/illegible cards) and the #billing-readout + prices update to the yearly figures; desktop_pricing_monthly_back toggles back to Monthly.
desktop_pricing_page and mobile_pricing_page verify the SAME billing control is present on the pricing page and desktop_contact_billing verifies it on the contact page (site-wide consistency).
desktop_faq_open opens the FAQ accordion to verify Bootstrap collapse behavior survives.
mobile_nav_open opens the mobile navbar to verify the original toggler behavior survives.

change_completion: The pricing section gains a Monthly/Yearly billing control (label, toggle, #billing-readout) and the plan grid + billing bar render within the viewport on mobile and tablet.
The same billing control appears on the home, pricing and contact pages.
Clicking Yearly updates the plan prices and the #billing-readout to the yearly period.
design_consistency: The billing control and plan grid preserve the Play palette, plan-card chrome, blue accent and section rhythm.
The Yearly state renders the plan cards cleanly (no overlap, clip or illegible text) and is visually faithful to the reference on the desktop and mobile pricing-yearly states.
interaction_continuity: Clicking the Yearly toggle updates the '#billing-readout' to 'Billing: Yearly · 2 months free' and swaps the plan prices to the yearly figures (post-click terminal state reflects the change, not the default Monthly).
regression: Navbar, hero, feature cards, FAQ accordion collapse, mobile navbar toggler and local hero/brand/team assets remain reachable and unchanged.
The static site serves from static HTML with a clean browser console.
responsive: 390px and 834px pricing states have no horizontal overflow beyond 24px.
The plan cards and billing bar wrap or shrink cleanly instead of forcing a fixed-width row.

scoring_notes: A correct patch adds the shared Monthly/Yearly billing control to the template's own pricing section, keeps the plan grid + billing bar within 390px/834px viewports, places the same control on the home + pricing + contact pages, keeps the Yearly state rendering the plan cards cleanly in the brand-blue palette, and wires the toggle so the prices, notes and #billing-readout reflect the clicked period. A patch that leaves the plan grid a fixed-width nowrap row (baseline) overflows on mobile/tablet; a 'smart-wrong' patch (bad) keeps the fixed-width nowrap grid + masks it with overflow-x:hidden (still overflows), places the control on the home page only (fails cross-page consistency), collapses the Yearly plan grid so the cards overlap/clip and the price and feature text wash out into an illegible near-white (fails visual fidelity), and snapshots the readout/prices into a stale closure so clicking Yearly moves the active pill but leaves #billing-readout and the prices frozen on Monthly (fails the interaction terminal-state check) while its text and console stay clean.
author_notes: Repo-grounded static UIdeck-Play marketing Edit/experience_continuity task hardened to L4 on the devhau/startup-template Tidechart site. The lever is the template's OWN three-tier pricing section (#pricing, native to index.html and pricing.html), enhanced with a Monthly/Yearly billing control (assets/css/plan-billing.css + assets/js/plan-billing.js). The reference (a) adds the .plan-billing bar + data-monthly/data-yearly plan prices and wraps the plan grid so it stays within 390px/834px, (b) places the same control on the home, pricing and contact pages (plan-billing--home/--pricing/--contact), (c) keeps the Yearly state rendering the plan cards cleanly in the light brand-blue Play palette, and (d) wires the toggle so the prices, notes and #billing-readout reflect the clicked period (live DOM read). The bad 'smart-wrong' solution keeps a fixed 940px nowrap plan grid + a decorative overflow-x:hidden (still overflows the document -> D6 fail on mobile/tablet), places the control on the home page ONLY (D2 cross-page fail on pricing + contact), collapses the Yearly plan grid so the cards overlap/clip and the price and feature text wash out to a near-white illegible tone (D3 visual_regression fail on the desktop/mobile pricing-yearly crops via pixelmatch, ssim and block_fidelity), and snapshots the readout + price labels into a stale closure so clicking Yearly moves the active pill and triggers the broken layout but leaves #billing-readout and the prices frozen on Monthly (click succeeds -> action_history clean, but the terminal readout is stale -> D4 interaction_assertions fail). It fails FOUR distinct gates while all text/completion/regression/console signals pass; the baseline shares the D6 overflow + home-only control but re-syncs the readout/prices live so it PASSES D4 (leg-orthogonal). INFRA identical across the three legs: the full Tidechart rebrand copy, the native pricing section markup with the .plan-billing shell and data-monthly/data-yearly attributes on the home page, the Google-AdSense remote script removal, and the template's body/section overflow-x:hidden clamps neutralized to overflow-x:visible so the mobile/tablet plan-grid overflow is a real, measurable document-width signal rather than a masked one.
